ruleDefinitions.name: Blackbyte Ransomware Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: BlackByte set three different registry values to escalate privileges and begin setting the stage for lateral movement and encryption Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: ((registry_path = "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\LocalAccountTokenFilterPolicy" OR registry_path = "HKLM\\SOFTWARE\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Policies\\System\\EnableLinkedConnections" OR registry_path = "HKLM\\SYSTEM\\CurrentControlSet\\Control\\FileSystem\\LongPathsEnabled") AND Details = "DWORD\ \(0x00000001\)")
